text_block_list.text:
Amidst the surging evening waves, the four 
temporary allies gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well now, everyone. And so, the summer we 
four classmates spent together has come to 
an end, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you reveal your plans for the 
autumn to me? What route are you 
considering to take down the Queen?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it seems the Queen, Buena Vista, has 
a particular obsession with the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is a well-known story at Tracen 
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Special Week-san, the Umamusume Buena 
Vista-san looks up to, carrying the hopes 
of the nation to victory in the Japan 
Cup...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That very scene is said to be the original 
landscape of the magnificent view Buena 
Vista seeks.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, it looks like she'll 
show up not just for the year-end Arima 
Kinen, but for the Japan Cup too.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I shall take the royal 
road—advancing from the Kikuka Sho to the 
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
For the honor of the Rose Clan, skipping 
the final jewel of the Classic Triple 
Crown, the Kikuka Sho, is not an option.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I will—not run in the Kikuka Sho. Aiming 
to run middle distances with peak 
precision—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
After running in the Gâ ¡ Kobe Shimbun 
Hai, we'll proceed to the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Pisa? Are you also going 
from the Kikuka Sho to the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, I am taking... a different path. I 
want to run with Buena Vista, but at the 
same time...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll start taking small steps 
forward. Towards "connecting with the 
world."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: What... The world, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm thinking of heading overseas this 
autumn. My goal is...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The pinnacle of world GⅠ racing, France's 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
After that, I plan on returning to Japan 
to run in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Running in the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" 
in October, and then the "Japan Cup" in 
November... What a punishing schedule...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Are you alright, Pisa-san?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I try my best not to pamper myself 
too much.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see, deliberately choosing the hardest 
route... You are quite the risk-taker, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if the probability of success is low, 
if we can slip through, it should grant us 
an overwhelming advantage.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: And so—Ruler, what about you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I will not be keeping in step with you 
all. In other words..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll be starting up last. Not aiming for 
the Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
From the Challenge Cup in early December, 
we head straight to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the path— it has split cleanly 
into four.
choice_data_list: Yeah, all of them are paths that fit you.

Yeah, each one... is a path that truly 
fits you.

text_block_list.text:
Not a single one among them chose their 
path lightly. Each and every one reflects 
their way of life clearly.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well everyone, see you again. At the 
year-end Arima Kinen! I'll tell you this 
much—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare drop out midway, alright? 
This session can only be truly sublime 
when every single one of us is together.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: —Ah! —Yes! ...Yes.

Having promised to reunite— the four 
players headed toward their respective 
boards.
